findings.description: Katalin Horák (recorded in the hint as Káti Liskovics) and István Banyári had a son, János Banyári, baptized 1 September 1844 in Kľak, Nová Baňa, close in time to the tree's existing son István (christened 15 April 1846).

target_person.name: János Banyári
target_person.birth: baptized 1 September 1844, Kľak, Nová Baňa, Slovakia

supporting_sources: Slovakia, Church and Synagogue Books, 1592-1935 — baptismal entry, 1 Sep 1844, Kľak, Nová Baňa, naming parents István Banyári and Káti Liskovics
